title: wasted model calls in launch P2b and P3, counted from the stored traces

findings.claim: The verifier loops on 5 of 477 tcga judge calls on P2b and 4 of 67 on P3 (the same inputs): after a JSON string value closes it repeats a carriage return and two spaces until the answer stops with the JSON open; a retry with more room repeats the loop
findings.note: Open. H-49 (docs/plan/measurements/verifier-constrained-decoding-2026-11-19.md): schema-constrained decoding is already on; the loop is whitespace between JSON tokens, which the pinned server allows unless started with disable_any_whitespace (a server flag, a serving change to qualify); no request-path fix exists on the pinned release

findings.claim: 10 ir_extract calls on sigir (7 on P2b, 3 on P3) timed out with no text, each at least the 180 s read timeout by the gateway's default; what the model was doing in them is not recorded
The stored traces record no finish reason, no tokens and no per-call time, so a cut answer, a call's model time and a timeout's cause can only be inferred from the text
